title: About
text:
Academic & Professional
Throughout my academic career, I have completed rigorous coursework including File Structure & Database, Operating System Concepts, and PHP and MySQL Programming, each of which has strengthened my technical foundation and practical skill set. Among my notable projects, I developed a database management system with a graphical user interface designed to efficiently retrieve and organize student and professor records. Additionally, as part of my Operating System Concepts course, I engineered a C-based web server capable of serving static files and performing mathematical operations directly through URL requests. Furthermore, I designed and built a PHP and MySQL powered website dedicated to whale anatomy education, featuring user registration, a guest list, and multiple informational pages.

title: About
text:
My Passion
From an early age, computers and technology have always fascinated me — not just as tools, but as a means to create, solve, and innovate. What truly drives me is the belief that technology has the power to transform lives and make a meaningful difference in society. I am deeply passionate about artificial intelligence, machine learning, and software development, and I find great excitement in exploring how these fields can be applied to solve real-world problems. I am currently developing a deeper understanding of open source collaboration, approaching it with care and responsibility as I learn the best and most secure practices to contribute confidently in the future. Whether I am building my own projects, conducting research, or exploring new innovations, my ultimate goal is to use technology as a force for good — creating solutions that are not only functional and efficient, but that genuinely help people and leave a lasting positive impact on the world.
